# OutSystems standards (Copilot)

When you generate or review OutSystems code, follow the rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Before writing modules, actions, entities or SQL, open the matching file in `skills/` and apply it:

- Modules: `skills/outsystems-module-naming/SKILL.md`
- Architecture: `skills/outsystems-architecture/SKILL.md`
- Action flows: `skills/outsystems-action-flows/SKILL.md`
- Entities and CRUD: `skills/outsystems-crud-conventions/SKILL.md`
- Advanced SQL: `skills/outsystems-advanced-sql/SKILL.md`
- Reviews: `skills/outsystems-standards-review/SKILL.md`
- Work item code review (Standards + Spec): `skills/outsystems-code-review/SKILL.md`
- LifeTime deployments: `skills/outsystems-lifetime-deploy/SKILL.md`

The skill files are the source of truth. If this file and a skill disagree, the skill wins.
